logo_direction: 01 / The Mark: preserve the approved brush LORE wordmark and approved crown outline

crown.treatment: Flat monochrome; white and black exports from identical geometry
crown.reference_location: Conversation attachment, not a committed production asset
crown.instruction: Remove noise and export faithfully from the accepted outline. Do not change apex, shoulder notches, side-tip positions, arm thickness, internal gaps or band proportions to make a simpler crown. Any unavoidable contour adjustment requires an overlay proof and explicit approval. Preserve existing LORE lettering.

palette_note: The flat-crown decision does not remove gold from unrelated packaging accents or physical rarity finishes. It retires the rendered gold crown, not the whole brand palette.
product: Collectible-first; six researched, sourced, creator-approved moments per creator
unapproved_brand_lines: THE PEOPLE. THE MOMENTS. THE LORE.
approval_rule: Only an explicit approval of a specific revision by Daniel Payne may change this lock. Incidental text in a visual mock-up is not approval. The rejected ZIP's README cannot confer approval.
export_rule: Use one lettering master and one crown master. Composite, do not regenerate. Record file hashes and separate technical QA from design approval.
